title: Revit governed object naming
test_intent: Determine whether governed Revit objects are classified to the correct naming surface and use the applicable governed syntax, token order, delimiter, and vocabulary without introducing a competing local convention.

applicability.applies_when: The tested Revit model contains governed families, family types, worksets, views, sheets, or other objects whose names are controlled by S4.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No object in the tested scope is subject to a governed naming rule.

required_evidence: inventory of tested Revit object names and object classes
applicable governed naming syntax and controlled vocabulary
record of approved naming exceptions where applicable

result_logic.pass: Every applicable tested object can be classified to a governed naming surface and its name conforms to the available governed syntax and vocabulary, with no unexplained duplicate or local convention.
result_logic.fail: One or more applicable objects violate an available governed naming syntax or vocabulary, introduce an unauthorized local convention, or create an unapproved ambiguous duplicate.
result_logic.not_applicable: No tested object is subject to a governed naming rule.
result_logic.indeterminate: The applicable naming syntax or controlled vocabulary is incomplete, unavailable, or insufficient to evaluate one or more tested objects.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E ATS. It deliberately returns indeterminate where the governed vocabulary is not yet complete instead of treating source examples as authority.
